source: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API (data/raw/heavenly_osm.json); elevation from AWS Terrain Tiles (Mapzen terrarium encoding)
license: OpenStreetMap data: ODbL 1.0 (c) OpenStreetMap contributors. Elevation: AWS Terrain Tiles (public domain / see dem_meta.json attribution)

methods.sampling: each OSM way is resampled to equal steps of <= 15 m along the polyline (haversine, R = 6371008.8 m); elevation bilinear from the DEM
methods.orientation: downhill direction is determined from DEM elevation (start vs end), not OSM vertex order; segments/coords/profile are stored top->bottom; vertex_order_uphill flags ways drawn uphill in OSM
methods.avg_grade_pct: (top_elev - bottom_elev) / length; for merged trails sum(segment drops) / sum(segment lengths)
methods.max_grade_pct: steepest 50 m window (elevation interpolated at exact window ends); max_grade_at_m = distance from the top where that window starts
methods.sustained_grade_pct: steepest 150 m window; windows_truncated=true means the way is shorter than the window and the whole length was used
methods.p90_grade_pct: 90th percentile of all 50 m window grades
methods.terrain_slope_pct: magnitude of the DEM gradient at each sample point (true fall-line steepness, independent of the trail's centreline direction)
methods.aspect_deg: slope-weighted circular mean of the DEM downhill aspect at the sample points (compass, 0=N 90=E): which way the terrain faces
methods.bearing_deg: length-weighted circular mean of the travel direction top->bottom (compass)
methods.climb_m: total uphill along the travel direction on the 25 m profile
methods.profile: [distance_from_top_m, elev_m] every 25 m plus the end point; for multi-segment trails 'chained' if segments join end-to-start within 10 m, else the longest segment's profile
methods.merging: ways sharing the same name are merged into one trail; stats aggregate as total length (sum of all segments, including parallel branches -- see max_segment_length_m for the longest single line), max of max/sustained grades, overall top-bottom drop; segments_relation is 'chained' (end-to-start), 'branches' (parallel/forked lines) or 'single'
methods.unnamed: unnamed ways are kept as separate trails named 'Unnamed (near <nearest named trail>)' (nearest by minimum point distance); connects_to lists named trails within 10 m of either endpoint; they are never merged into named trails
methods.id: slug(name) + '-' + sorted OSM way ids (stable while OSM way ids are stable)
methods.area: resort side (California/Nevada) by majority vote of three lift-proximity signals: side of nearest_lift (lift TOP nearest the trail top), side of lift_at_bottom (lift LINE nearest the trail bottom point) and side of lift_at_centroid (lift LINE nearest the trail centroid). Lifts get their side from Heavenly's trail map (LIFT_SIDE in build_trails.py). area_votes holds the three sides and area_confidence is 'low' when they disagree (ridge/connector runs). This is the resort's marketing side, not the surveyed CA/NV state line
methods.osm_difficulty: piste:difficulty (easy/intermediate/advanced/expert); hardest kept when segments disagree

data_quality_issues: lift 'Little Mule' (way 257192523) is drawn top->bottom in OSM (convention is bottom->top); reversed
lift 'Little Mule' (way 257192523) has only 1.2 m vertical
lift 'Unnamed magic carpet' (way 1211522974) has only 3.2 m vertical
no landuse=winter_sports relation found; boundary.json not written
16 trails shorter than 150 m: sustained/max windows truncated to the whole length: ['5 Trees', "Barry's Cornice", 'Cascade', 'Creekside', 'Flat Pine', 'Lower Cascade', 'Mystic', 'Old School']
3 trails have >15 m of uphill along the travel direction (traverses/road-like or DEM noise): Comstock Glade (+84 m), Little Red Glade (+59 m), Wild Card (+22 m)
1 trails have no piste:difficulty tag: ['Unnamed (near Silver Dollar)']
4 trails whose bottom is >400 m from any lift line (end on another run / mid-canyon): Beehive (418 m), Bruce's (550 m), Comstock Glade (564 m), Washoe Zephyr (580 m)
